package.name: zero_bringup
package.description: Launch + controller configuration for the ZERO bimanual reBot workstation under mujoco_ros2_control (PAL Robotics). Brings up robot_state_publisher, converts the URDF to MJCF and publishes it on /mujoco_robot_description, starts mujoco_ros2_control's own ros2_control_node, and spawns one trajectory controller per arm and per gripper.
